# Creative Emman Limited

> Creative Emman Limited is a creative and technology company based in Rivers State, Nigeria. The company works with startups, founders, businesses, and organisations locally and internationally.

Official website: https://www.creativeemmanlimited.com/

## Core services

- Website development
- UI/UX design
- Graphic and brand design
- Social media management
- Videography
- Video editing
- Motion graphics design
- Photography
